name: Spire
description: Since time immemorial, bugs have sought to rise above their lot. The foundations of magic are laid beneath their towers of hubris.

abilities.name: Soul Totem
abilities.description: Create Soul Totem holding Soul up to Spire Rank. Spend 1 Stamina to draw Soul from carried Totem.

abilities.name: Arcane Casting
abilities.description: Treat arcane foci as Sorcerous weapons. Talismans make unarmed strikes/grapples Sorcerous weapons.

abilities.name: Spiral Energy
abilities.description: May dedicate Soul dice to opposed Insight checks for Spells/abilities.

abilities.name: Soul Extraction
abilities.description: Gain 1 Soul when damaging bugs with a Spell.

abilities.name: Spell Splicing
abilities.description: Merge two Arcana when attuning spells. Second spell piggybacks on first. AoE delivery increases Difficulty by 1.

abilities.name: Distant Thunder
abilities.description: AoE Spells in line/cone/burst can originate from anywhere within Spell range.
